description: Evaluates whether the skill enforces web accessibility and design best practices

criteria.description: Must check and enforce 4.5:1 minimum contrast ratio for text
Must include focus-visible styles and keyboard navigation for all interactive elements
Must use semantic HTML elements (nav, main, article, section) not div soup
Must include ARIA labels on icon-only buttons, modals, and form fields
Must handle images responsively (srcset, lazy loading, alt text)
Must include accessible form validation with error messages linked to fields

testPrompt: Review this component for accessibility: A modal dialog with a form containing name, email, phone inputs, a submit button, and a close button (X icon). The modal has a dark overlay background.
